title: Statewide rent cap (AB 1482 / SB 567)
requirement: Landlords cannot increase rent over a 12-month period by more than 5% plus local CPI inflation, or 10% total, whichever is lower. Rent cannot be raised in more than two increments during that 12-month period.
requirement_es: Los propietarios no pueden aumentar el alquiler en un período de 12 meses en más del 5% más la inflación local del IPC, o el 10% en total, lo que sea menor. El alquiler no se puede aumentar en más de dos incrementos durante ese período de 12 meses.

title: Statewide Just Cause Eviction Protections (AB 1482)
requirement: Landlords cannot terminate a tenancy without stating an at-fault or no-fault just cause once a tenant has continuously occupied the property for 12 months (or 24 months if adult tenants were added). For no-fault evictions, the landlord must provide relocation assistance or a rent waiver equal to one month's rent.

En los desalojos sin culpa, el propietario debe proporcionar asistencia de reubicación o una exención de alquiler equivalente a un mes de alquiler.

title: Statewide residential security deposit limit
requirement: Except as provided in paragraph (2), (3), or (5), a landlord shall not demand or receive security, however denominated, in an amount or value in excess of an amount equal to one month’s rent, in addition to any rent for the first month paid on or before initial occupancy.

title: Application screening fee cap and requirements
requirement: Landlords may charge an application screening fee capped at actual out-of-pocket costs and no more than $30 (adjusted annually for CPI since 1998). Landlords cannot charge a fee if no unit is available, must follow specific application-processing procedures, and must provide an itemized receipt and copy of any consumer credit report obtained.
requirement_es: Los propietarios pueden cobrar una tarifa de evaluación de solicitud limitada a los costos directos reales y no más de $30 (ajustados anualmente por el IPC desde 1998). No pueden cobrarla si no hay una unidad disponible, deben seguir procedimientos específicos para procesar solicitudes y deben entregar un recibo desglosado y una copia del informe de crédito del consumidor obtenido.

key_value.label: maximum screening fee
key_value.value: $30 per applicant, adjusted annually for CPI since 1998

precedence.source_language: This section is not intended to preempt any provisions or regulations that govern the collection of deposits and fees under federal or state housing assistance programs.

quoted_span:
The amount of the application screening fee shall not be greater than the actual
out-of-pocket costs of gathering information concerning the applicant, including, but not limited to, the cost of using a tenant screening service or a consumer credit reporting service, and the reasonable value of time spent by the landlord or their agent in obtaining information on the applicant. In no case shall the amount of the application screening fee charged by the landlord or their agent be greater than thirty dollars ($30) per applicant. The thirty dollar ($30) application screening fee may be adjusted annually by the landlord or their agent commensurate with an increase in the Consumer Price Index, beginning on January 1, 1998.

title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance Annual Rent Increase Limit
requirement: Landlords of covered rental units may increase rent no more than once every 12 months, based on the annual percentage change in the regional Consumer Price Index as published by the Department, with a minimum increase of 3% and a maximum of 8%. An additional 1% may be added for each utility (gas or electric) if fully paid by the landlord, up to an additional 2%.

Se puede agregar un 1% adicional por cada servicio público (gas o electricidad) pagado en su totalidad por el propietario, hasta un máximo del 2% adicional.

title: Unlawful Evictions, Notice, and Tenant Protections (San Francisco Rent Ordinance)
requirement: Landlords may not endeavor to recover possession or evict a tenant except on the specific enumerated just-cause grounds authorized under Section 37.9. Tenants must be provided required written notices, including a 10-day notice to cure for certain lease violations, and protected classes (such as qualifying elderly, disabled, or school-year educators/families) have specialized protections against certain no-fault evictions.
requirement_es: Es ilegal que un propietario intente desalojar o desaloje a un inquilino excepto bajo las causales justificadas explícitamente autorizadas bajo la Sección 37.9. Los inquilinos deben recibir las notificaciones requeridas por escrito, incluido un período de subsanación de 10 días para ciertas infracciones, y ciertas clases protegidas (adultos mayores, personas con discapacidades o familias/educadores durante el año escolar) tienen protecciones adicionales contra ciertos desalojos sin falta.

title: Relocation Payments and Re-Rental Restrictions for Ellis Act Displacements
requirement: Landlords withdrawing units from the rental market under the Ellis Act must provide statutory relocation payments per eligible tenant (with extra payments for seniors or disabled tenants) and comply with strict re-rental and rent restrictions if the units are returned to the rental market within 5 to 10 years.
requirement_es: Los propietarios que retiran unidades del mercado de alquiler bajo la Ley Ellis deben proporcionar pagos legales de reubicación por inquilino elegible (con pagos adicionales para personas de la tercera edad o con discapacidades) y cumplir con estrictas restricciones de re-alquiler y límites de renta si las unidades vuelven a ofrecerse en alquiler dentro de 5 a 10 años.

title: Eviction Protections After Foreclosure
requirement: Tenants occupying a rental unit at the time of foreclosure cannot be evicted by the successor owner who took title through foreclosure without just cause under Section 37.9 or before the expiration of their existing lease, whichever is later, and must be provided written notice of their rights within 15 days.
requirement_es: Los inquilinos que ocupen una unidad al momento de una ejecución hipotecaria no pueden ser desalojados por el nuevo titular que obtuvo la propiedad tras la ejecución, salvo por causa justificada bajo la Sección 37.9 o al finalizar el contrato de arrendamiento existente (lo que ocurra más tarde), y deben recibir notificación por escrito de sus derechos dentro de 15 días.
penalty: Failure to provide mandatory foreclosure notices serves as a complete defense to an eviction under Section 37.9.

Chapter 37, or at the end of the tenant's existing lease, whichever occurs later.

title: Prohibition of Fixed-Term Agreements Circumventing Just Cause
requirement: Lease provisions requiring a tenant to vacate at the end of a stated term or classifying failure to vacate at term expiration as just cause for eviction are void as contrary to public policy, unless Chapter 37 expressly authorizes a fixed term.
requirement_es: Las disposiciones contractuales que exigen que un inquilino desocupe la unidad al vencer un plazo fijo o que califiquen la falta de desocupación como justa causa de desalojo son nulas por ser contrarias al orden público, salvo que el Capítulo 37 autorice expresamente dicho plazo fijo.
penalty: Civil penalties up to two times amount paid or received; administrative penalties up to $100 per day (up to $1,000 per listing defect); reasonable attorney's fees.

tenant’s failure to vacate the rental unit at the end of the stated term as a just cause for eviction

(either of them, a “Fixed-Term Agreement”), shall be void as contrary to public policy, and a

landlord may not attempt to recover possession of the unit without just cause.

title: Security Deposit Interest Requirement
requirement: Landlords holding any security deposit or advance rent must hold it in a fiduciary capacity and pay simple interest annually in December (via cash or rent rebate) and upon move-out, at a rate based on local 6-month CD interest rates determined by the Rent Board.
requirement_es: Los propietarios que retengan un depósito de seguridad o pago por adelantado deben conservarlo en carácter fiduciario y pagar intereses simples anualmente en diciembre (mediante reembolso de alquiler o pago en efectivo) y al desocupar la vivienda, a una tasa basada en las tasas de interés locales de certificados de depósito a seis meses determinadas por la Junta de Estabilización del Alquiler.

Any payment or deposit of monies by the tenant, the primary function of which is to secure
the performance of a rental agreement or any part of such agreement, including an
advance payment of rent, shall be held by the landlord, in a fiduciary capacity for the
benefit of the tenant and shall accrue simple interest at the rate equal to the average rates
of interest paid on six-month certificates of deposit by banks doing business in the City
until such time as the payment or deposit is returned to the tenant or entitled to be used
by the landlord as provided in Civil Code Section 1950.5.

title: Annual General Adjustment of Rent Ceilings
requirement: Annual general rent adjustments take effect January 1 and are capped at 65% of the regional CPI-U increase, between 0% and a maximum of 5%. Landlords must provide at least 30 days' advance written notice and be in compliance with registration, habitability, and repair orders.
requirement_es: Los ajustes generales anuales de alquiler entran en vigor el 1 de enero y tienen un límite del 65% del aumento del IPC-U regional, entre un mínimo de 0% y un máximo de 5%. Los propietarios deben entregar una notificación por escrito con al menos 30 días de anticipación y estar al día con el registro, la habitabilidad y las órdenes de reparación.

title: Just Cause Eviction Protections
requirement: A landlord may only recover possession of a covered rental unit for one of the enumerated just causes, including nonpayment of rent (exceeding one month's HUD FMR), lease breach causing substantial actual injury, substantial damage, nuisance, refusal of lawful access, substantial repairs, demolition, or owner/relative move-in. Owner move-in evictions require standard relocation assistance of $15,000 (plus $5,000 for qualifying low-income, disabled, elderly, minor children, or long-term tenancies).
requirement_es: El propietario solo puede desalojar a un inquilino de una vivienda cubierta por una de las causas justificadas establecidas por ley, tales como falta de pago del alquiler (que exceda un mes del HUD FMR), incumplimiento del contrato que cause daño real sustancial, daños graves, molestias a la paz, negativa de acceso legal, reparaciones sustanciales, demolición o mudanza del propietario o familiar. Los desalojos por mudanza del propietario exigen una asistencia de reubicación estándar de $15,000 (más $5,000 adicionales para hogares de bajos ingresos, con discapacidades, adultos mayores, menores de edad o inquilinos de larga duración).

title: Berkeley Ban on Pricing Algorithms to Set Rents
requirement: Landlords are prohibited from using pricing algorithms that analyze competitor data to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units. Selling, licensing, or providing such pricing algorithms to Berkeley landlords is also unlawful.
requirement_es: Se prohíbe a los propietarios utilizar algoritmos de fijación de precios que analicen datos de competidores para fijar alquileres o gestionar niveles de ocupación en unidades residenciales. También es ilegal vender, licenciar o proporcionar dichos algoritmos de fijación de precios a los propietarios de Berkeley.

title: Annual Rent Increase Limit
requirement: Rent increases are capped at 3% or 80% of the change in CPI (whichever is less) and are restricted to no more than one rent increase in any 12-month period. If the change in CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.
requirement_es: Los aumentos de alquiler tienen un límite del 3% o el 80% de la variación del IPC (lo que sea menor) y no se permite más de un aumento en cualquier período de 12 meses. Si la variación del IPC es negativa, no se permite ningún aumento de alquiler.

requirement: A landlord cannot require more than 1.5 times one month's rent as a security deposit. Any annual increase in the security deposit cannot exceed 10 percent of the current security deposit.
requirement_es: El arrendador no puede exigir más de 1.5 veces el monto de un mes de alquiler como depósito de seguridad. Cualquier aumento anual del depósito no puede exceder el 10 por ciento del depósito de seguridad actual.

title: Return of security deposit deadline and double damages penalty
requirement: Landlords must return the security deposit plus accrued interest, minus itemized allowable deductions, within 30 days of lease termination (or within 5 business days if displaced by fire, flood, condemnation, or evacuation, or 15 business days for domestic violence lease termination). A tenant wrongfully denied their deposit is entitled to double the amount wrongfully withheld, plus costs and reasonable attorney's fees.
requirement_es: Los arrendadores deben devolver el depósito de seguridad más los intereses acumulados, menos las deducciones desglosadas permitidas, dentro de los 30 días posteriores a la terminación del contrato (o dentro de 5 días hábiles si fue desplazado por incendio, inundación, expropiación o evacuación, o 15 días hábiles por rescisión debido a violencia doméstica). El inquilino a quien se le retenga indebidamente su depósito tiene derecho al doble de la cantidad retenida indebidamente, más costas y honorarios de abogados.

title: Criminal History Screening Restrictions (Fair Chance in Housing Act)
requirement: Landlords cannot inquire into an applicant's criminal history or evaluate criminal records prior to making a conditional offer, subject to limited exceptions for sex offender registration and methamphetamine production. After a conditional offer, landlords may only consider specified serious or recent convictions, must conduct an individualized assessment, and must allow the applicant an opportunity to dispute inaccuracies or show rehabilitation before withdrawing the offer.
requirement_es: Los propietarios no pueden consultar el historial penal de un solicitante ni evaluarlo antes de hacer una oferta condicional, salvo excepciones limitadas relacionadas con el registro de delincuentes sexuales y la producción de metanfetamina. Tras una oferta condicional, solo pueden considerar ciertas condenas graves o recientes, deben realizar una evaluación individualizada y permitir que el solicitante impugne inexactitudes o demuestre rehabilitación antes de retirar la oferta.

quoted_span:
A housing provider shall not require an applicant to complete any housing application that includes any inquiries regarding
an applicant's criminal record prior to the provision of a conditional offer, except that a housing provider may consider whether
an applicant has ever been convicted of drug-related criminal activity for the manufacture or production of methamphetamine
on the premises of federally assisted housing, and whether the applicant is subject to a lifetime registration requirement under
a State sex offender registration program.
(2) A housing provider shall not make any oral or written inquiry regarding an applicant's criminal record prior to making a
conditional offer.

title: Jersey City Algorithmic Rent-Fixing Prohibition
requirement: Landlords and their agents are prohibited from subscribing to, contracting with, or exchanging value for the services of a pricing service provider that coordinates nonpublic competitor rental data or recommends rents, lease terms, or occupancy levels. Service providers are also barred from facilitating non-compete agreements among housing providers.
requirement_es: Se prohíbe a los arrendadores y sus agentes suscribirse, contratar o intercambiar cualquier cosa de valor por los servicios de un proveedor que coordine datos no públicos de competidores o recomiende precios de alquiler, términos de arrendamiento o niveles de ocupación. Los proveedores de servicios tampoco pueden facilitar acuerdos de no competencia entre arrendadores.

title: Security deposit limit and holding requirements
requirement: A security deposit cannot exceed the first month's rent. The landlord must hold it in a separate interest-bearing bank account, provide a receipt and condition statement, pay annual interest, and return the deposit within 30 days after the tenancy ends minus only permitted deductions.

title: Broker licensing requirement for charging rental finding fees
requirement: No person may charge a fee to find dwelling accommodations for prospective tenants unless they are a licensed real estate broker or salesperson.
